Tap to choose what to lock (Slack, work Gmail or both) and for how long.
Setup needed: the next tap explains Accessibility access, then opens Android Settings.
No in-app undo. To stop early, disable Slack Lock in Accessibility Settings or uninstall it.
No in-app undo for active locks. Tap to lock the rest too.
The timer is still active, but locked apps are reachable because Accessibility is off.
Enter your work address to lock just that account, or your work domain (e.g. @example.org) to lock every account on it. Other Gmail accounts stay usable.
Enter an email address or a domain like @example.org.
Can\'t change the work account while work Gmail is locked.

Slack Lock needs Accessibility permission to detect when Slack or your work Gmail opens during an active lock and send you back home. 

In the next screen, find "Slack Lock" and toggle it on. 

If the toggle is greyed out (Android 13+), go back to App info, tap the ⋮ menu in the top-right and choose "Allow restricted settings" first.

Slack Lock uses Android Accessibility only to enforce locks you start.

Slack: it receives Slack window-change events and sends you to the home screen.

Work Gmail: Gmail uses one app for all accounts, so while a work Gmail lock is active Slack Lock reads Gmail's account button to see which account is open, and sends you home if it is your work account. During that lock it also notices when you switch apps, so it can recheck the account.

It does not read other apps' screens, messages, typed text, notifications, files, or contacts, and it does not collect or share data.
What do you want to lock?
Choose at least one thing to lock.
Choose a duration from 15 minutes to 14 days.
Opening %1$s before %2$s will return you to the home screen. There is no in-app undo. To stop early, disable Slack Lock in Accessibility Settings or uninstall it.
\n\nOther Gmail accounts stay usable. If Gmail opens straight into an email (e.g. from a notification), Slack Lock steps back to the inbox to check which account it is.

Detects when Slack, or your work account in Gmail, is opened during an active lock and sends you back to the home screen. Reads only Gmail\'s account button, only during a Gmail lock. Does not collect, store, or transmit any data.
